catalyst_tone.disclaimer: Context only — not a signal. This is a machine DIGEST of a public document, produced by an AI model after the fact. The tone / guidance / risk / reversibility readings are background context; they are NOT inputs to any score, signal or allocation unless a downstream, separately-gated step promotes a single field, and even then only as one bounded factor. “unknown” means the evidence was insufficient — the honest answer. dislocation.headline: No acute dislocation — markets are not in a stress washout.

gate2.label: Entry timer arms only inside a buyable washout.
gate2.measured: Matched buyable washouts (2006+): waiting for the term un-inversion lifted hit 61→67%, median 63d return +2.2→+4.6%, median drawdown −4.5→−2.9%; the 1-in-10 tail was marginally worse. A confirm, not a bottom-caller.

evidence.robust: Put-present washouts had ~4pp shallower MEDIAN 3-month drawdown than put-absent — the one effect whose 95% CI excludes zero ([+0.3, +6.3], episode block bootstrap, SPY 1997-2026).
evidence.sign_consistent: Higher hit-rate and a shallower 1-year tail point the same way but their CIs span zero at ~10 effective crises — carried by leave-one-year-out (26/28 years) and BOTH split-halves, not significance.
evidence.caveat: A drawdown / risk filter, not a return signal. In a Fed-put regime even knife-looking dips often recover; in a put-absent regime (recession or inflation-locked) the same capitulation signals caught the 2000/2008/2022 falling knife.

cross_asset.headline: CONCENTRATED — 3 of 6 markets are one bet (US, Commodities, Dollar). Cross-asset correlation is in the top 2% of its 5y range: stacking these views is doubling one liquidity/risk exposure, not diversifying.
cross_asset.evidence: Absorption ratio = PC1 variance share (Kritzman-Page 2010): high/rising absorption marks a fragile one-factor regime that has historically led drawdowns. Daily closes across US/Asia/24-7 crypto carry a timezone lead/lag — a coarse regime gauge, not a hedge ratio.

portfolio.headline: Equal-weighting all 6 market views puts 38% of portfolio RISK in one market (vs 17% if truly balanced); ERC rebalances to ~equal risk (heaviest weight: Dollar 0.43). Diversification ratio 1.69.
portfolio.evidence: Risk budgeting on the trailing covariance: equal-weight vs inverse-vol vs equal-risk-contribution. Stress replay = equal-weight book of the then-available markets through named crises. A risk-budget reference, not a trade list; same timezone caveat as cross_asset.
